text: Know where the first aid kit is before you start working.
Ask your grown-up to show you.
Small cut? Tell a grown-up, wash it with clean water, and cover it with a bandage.
Splinter? Do not dig at it. A grown-up can take it out with clean tweezers.
Anything in your eye, a big cut, or a bump on the head: stop and get a grown-up right away.

tip.text: Always tell a grown-up when you get hurt, even if it seems small.
